correctness.rationale: For a_i,b_i a path a_i–b_j–a_k–b_i with i,j,k distinct establishes distance 3, since they are in opposite shores and not adjacent. Any two same-shore vertices have a common neighbor and nonmatched cross-shore vertices are adjacent. Thus the closed radius-2 ball at any vertex omits only its unique antipode. A set of size at least two meets every such ball, and a singleton misses the ball of its antipode. This proves the iff for proper colorings and the upper limit n. To realize q=2,…,n, use q−2 matched nonedges as classes and two residual shores each of size n−q+2≥2, valid also at n=3. At distance 1 an independent dominating class is either a whole shore (all same-shore vertices must be dominated) or one matched nonedge (the only mixed independent class). A whole-shore class forces the other whole shore; otherwise all classes are matched nonedges. At d≥3 the fall condition is automatic, and splitting shores with disjoint palettes gives all proper color counts 2,…,2n. The packaged artifacts/verify.py was inspected, not executed; its finite enumeration is optional corroboration and does not replace the structural proof.

evidence: Every connected 3-colorable graph of order at least 3 has a distance-2 fall 3-coloring. Every connected bipartite graph of order at least d+1 has a partition into d+1 independent distance-d dominating classes. The associated minimum-class-size bound is not a partition spectrum.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Both theorems specialize to q=3 at radius 2. Diameter 2 would make every proper coloring eligible, but crowns have diameter 3 and singleton classes violate the distance-2 condition.

value.rationale: The crown is a natural test family just beyond the diameter-2 case in distance-fall theory. The radius-2 result detects and exactly describes the obstruction to automatic feasibility, gives all attainable color counts rather than a single existence statement, and exhibits a full transition between ordinary fall and unrestricted proper coloring. The value is in that structural middle regime, not in recomputing the conventional endpoints.
